column1: # Census cost of each Layer C1cn member, in seconds on a hosted runner.
# Read by census_shard_plan.py to deal the members to the census shards. The weights decide
# balance only: a member with no row is planned at the median, and a row for a crate that is no
# member is ignored. Both are named on the census job's stderr.
# Source: run 44778189472 (589a8884c9), both census shards complete: the time from one
# `census:` line to the next. A member that printed no line then (no test only a feature build
# reaches) is folded into the next printed member's interval, and that interval is split evenly
# among the members it holds; those rows are marked "split". Today the census prints `(Ns)`
# after every member, so a refresh reads each member's own figure.
wz-tls-record                   9   # split with the next four
